game.name: Dead Or Alive 4 (USA, Europe)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Zh,Ko)(Rev 1)
game.desc: Dead or Alive 4 on Xbox 360 is a fighting game that is essentially based on the notion of sequences and counter sequences. On the menu: new characters, tons of outfits to unlock and tons of moves for each fighter... It's going to be a blast!
